questions.q: A customer runs Zebra ZD421d 4-inch desktop label printers and wants the lowest delivered price. Which replacement leads?
questions.e: The Bixolon XD5-40 is the default ZD421d replacement on all displacement and new business. Toshiba BV420D is quoted only on explicit customer request or where an existing Toshiba estate applies.

questions.q: A customer has Zebra TC26 handhelds and needs integrated cellular. What does IOR offer?
questions.e: The TC26/27 (cellular-capable tier) maps to the Urovo DT40 4G or RT40 4G.

questions.q: A customer runs Zebra MC3300x keypad warehouse units. What does IOR replace them with?
questions.e: The pistol-grip MC3300/MC3300x maps to the Urovo DT40 with gun grip, or the RT40.

questions.q: Zebra DS9308 to Datalogic, ZD421 to Bixolon — what replaces a Zebra TC or MC handheld computer?
questions.e: Urovo is the handheld pillar of the displacement strategy and IOR's primary replacement for Zebra TC and MC mobile computers.
